uq_action_allocations_live_placement.name: uq_action_allocations_live_placement
uq_action_allocations_live_placement.where: released_at IS NULL AND grant_id IS NOT NULL AND spent_micro_usd < amount_micro_usd

ck_attachments_body_location.name: ck_attachments_body_location
ck_attachments_body_location.value: (storage = 'db' AND body IS NOT NULL) OR (storage = 's3' AND storage_key IS NOT NULL)

ck_curation_requests_defect.name: ck_curation_requests_defect
ck_curation_requests_defect.value: defect IS NULL OR defect IN ('duplicate', 'conflation', 'wrong_kind', 'mislabeled_edge', 'missing_link', 'bad_merge', 'other')

ck_judgment_inputs_shape.name: ck_judgment_inputs_shape
ck_judgment_inputs_shape.value:
("judgment_inputs"."input_kind" = 'premise' AND "judgment_inputs"."node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "judgment_inputs"."relation_type" IS NOT NULL AND "judgment_inputs"."source_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("judgment_inputs"."input_kind" = 'source' AND "judgment_inputs"."source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "judgment_inputs"."node_id" IS NULL)

uq_permission_grants_live_account.name: uq_permission_grants_live_account
uq_permission_grants_live_account.where: removed_at IS NULL AND account_id IS NOT NULL

uq_permission_grants_live_group.name: uq_permission_grants_live_group
uq_permission_grants_live_group.where: removed_at IS NULL AND group_name IS NOT NULL

ck_permission_grants_removal.name: ck_permission_grants_removal
ck_permission_grants_removal.value: ("permission_grants"."removed_by" IS NULL) OR ("permission_grants"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)
